{{Quote|The Torgaigne are just some bunch of provincial racketeers. They ain't likely to cause a ship the Falcon's size any trouble.|Han Solo, shortly before the Torgaigne causes him trouble|<ref name="TPE" />}}
The '''Exalted Torgaigne''' was a crime syndicate that operated out of [[Attahox/Legends|Attahox]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. Much of the organization's revenue was generated from the sale of [[phosovane salts]], which were used as a base for painkillers on some [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Torgaigne had had several run-ins with notorious [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who regarded their operation as small-time but thought of Torgaigne boss [[Vor Childermoss]] as particularly formidable.<ref name="TPE" />

The Torgaigne made use of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] known as [[Octofoil|Octofoils]].<ref name="TPE" />
